quote: Why do you carry such heavy grief? When tomorrow was never promised to you. We mourn for gardens we never planted. We weep for doors that never opened. But time refuses to slow its pace. And shadows fade when morning finally breaks. So why do you bleed for yesterday? When the present is all you own.
